title: Error when setting connection or tab color: Object of type 'System.Drawing.Color' cannot be converted to type 'System.String'.
author: JohnnyPrimus
body_snippet: When configuring a VNC (also tested RDP) connection, selecting a color or a tab color fails...no color is shown in the color box, and an error is thrown. Upon clicking details, it seems the selection box is trying to use the color directly as a string (Error when setting connection or tab color: Object of type 'System.Drawing.Color' cannot be converted to type 'System.String'.). See below for example

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the screenshot — the exact wording of that error is what identified the mechanism straight away.

`Color` and `TabColor` are stored as text (a colour name or a hex string), but they carried the stock colour editor, which is built for `Color`-typed properties: it always hands back a `System.Drawing.Color`, and the property grid assigns an editor's result straight through without consulting the type converter.
